sentences.text: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
ORDER 09.05.2024 Counsel for the both sides are hopeful of settlement of the matter relating to the compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 through the medium of Lok Adalat.
Let the matter be posted before the next Lok Adalat for enabling the parties to settle the matter in mutual understanding with each other.
It is expected that both the parties would make an earnest endeavour to settle the matter.
List the matter before the Lok Adalat.
(RAHUL BHARTI) JUDGE JAMMU 09.05.2024 Muneesh Reva Sharma vs Ramesh Singh And Others on 9 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182929403/
